# Tarang Sachaniya

> Tarang Sachaniya is a full-stack developer based in Ahmedabad, India, with a backend lean: Node.js, TypeScript, Bun, Hono, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Laravel. He co-founded Priinteve Innovations LLP, where he builds an on-demand printing network, NFC digital business cards, QR restaurant ordering and tools for print shops and salons.

## Projects
- [Priinteve Print Network](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/priinteve-print-network/): On-demand printing with an invisible vendor network. Pre-launch, 2025.
- [Nectcard](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/nectcard/): NFC and QR digital business cards. Live, 2025.
- [VentaDot](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/ventadot/): QR table ordering for restaurants, on every screen. Live, 2025.
- [Zerox Buddy](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/zerox-buddy/): QR printing for xerox, print and cyber café shops. Live, 2026.
- [Salonly](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/salonly/): Salon bookings with no sign-up. Live, 2026.
- [Royal Timber](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/royal-timber/): Website for a plywood supplier. Shipped, 2026.
- [Quantivo](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/quantivo/): Website for a digital marketing agency. Shipped, 2026.
- [EarthOra](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/earthora/): Cashew brand storefront, mobile concept. Concept, 2026.
- [otp-forge](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/otp-forge/): Zero-dependency OTP library on npm. Shipped, 2025.
- [Smart Attendance System](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/smart-attendance-system/): Fingerprint + face-verified attendance. Archived, 2024.
- [COVID-19 Data Analysis](https://tarangsachaniya.com/work/covid-19-data-analysis/): Cleaning, plotting and predicting. Archived, 2023.
